messages.content: I’ll sell the initial battery energy in the highest-priced overnight DA hour, refill from solar that would otherwise be curtailed, and reserve the next discharge for the evening peak. I’ll also book enough late-night charging to meet the 100 MWh end-of-day target, then reassess at each live watch.

The battery has refilled to 200 MWh from otherwise-curtailed solar. Recent RT prices have fallen below DA prices, but there are no notices or forward RT prices to support changing the evening plan. I’m keeping the peak-hour discharge and late-night recharge book.
